record.content: 2026 NPS Stock Users Guide p14, with p3 definitions and 2026 grazing map: 46-5: large wet alpine meadow between JMT and Taboose Pass; 12-acre wet meadow at 10,920 feet closed to grazing; no stock camps or drift fences. Existing general webpage rounds elevation to 11,000 feet; do not use either as a surveyed boundary.
